mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course(name, description, college, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{college}, 1, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE course SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, college = #{college}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM course
name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
